title: Extending property tax relief for wildfire-hit properties
summary: Bill 103 now changes the budget tied to the real property tax expiry date for wildfire-impacted properties, as of August 25. The bill would extend the property tax exemption for those properties to June 30, 2028. The budget director said this updates the exemption's end date to line up with Ordinance 5913.
